data.name: Qazafi
data.gender_notes: Qazafi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Qasif' which means 'wise, intelligent, or clever'. The name Qazafi carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Qazafi usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth.
data.etymology: Qazafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qazafi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قزافي
in_arabic.meaning: القزافي يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالشجاعة و القوة في القتال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قزافي مشتق من الجذر العربي قزف، والذي يعني الرمي أو الطرح. يوحي الاسم بالشجاعة و القوة في القتال، كما كان يستخدم في العصور الوسطى لوصف المحاربين الأشداء. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يحمل الاسم دلالة على الصبر و الثبات في وجه التحديات.

in_urdu.name: قزافی
in_urdu.meaning: قزافی کا مطلب ہے کسی کو شجاعت اور طاقت سے کام لینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: قزافی نام عربی جڑ قزف سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رمی یا دھکیلنا۔ یہ نام شجاعت اور طاقت کی علامت ہے، خاص طور پر جنگ میں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام دلیری اور ثابت قدم ہونے کی خصوصیات سے وابستہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ज़ाफ़ी
in_hindi.meaning: क़ज़ाफ़ी का अर्थ है किसी को साहस और शक्ति से काम लेने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ज़ाफ़ी नाम अरबी मूल قزف से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है फेंकना या धकेलना। यह नाम साहस और शक्ति का प्रतीक है, विशेष रूप से युद्ध में। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बहादुरी और दृढ़ता के गुणों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: قزافي
in_pashto.meaning: قزافي يعني د قتال په ځواک او شجاعت سره
in_pashto.long_meaning: د قزافي نوم د عربي ريښې قزف څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د رمي يا طرح کولو معنا لري. دا نوم د شجاعت او ځواک په ځانګړي ډول په جګړه کې څرګندوي. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د زړورتیا او استقامت ځانګړتیاو سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Qazafi
in_english.meaning: Qazafi means one who acts with courage and strength in battle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qazafi is derived from the Arabic root قزف (qazaf), which means to throw or fling. Historically, it was used to describe brave and strong warriors. In Islamic tradition, Qazafi signifies resilience and steadfastness in the face of challenges. The name is associated with attributes of bravery, determination, and strength.

In Islamic traditions, knowledge is considered a gift from Allah, and seeking it is a worthy pursuit. Therefore, bearing the name Qazafi can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual duty to strive for knowledge and wisdom throughout one's life, as well as a reflection of the individual's commitment to follow this path. By upholding this spiritual significance, the individual can not only honor their given name but contribute positively to their community and society as a whole.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Qazafi symbolizes relentless determination and persistence, as one who strives to uproot injustice and evil from the world, just as the crabs (Qazaf) firmly cling and move in unison towards their goal. The spiritual meaning lies in the individual's commitment to purify their own soul and contribute to the betterment of society.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Qazafi is mentioned in the book 'The History of the Islamic Golden Age' by Ibn Khaldun. The name Qazafi carried significant weight in that era.
